title: Word to Bits
text: Converts real numbers to vector of bits, 1 input, 1 output; {Maximum Word Length} sets the maximum output word length and {Output bit order}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output signal binary-valued scalar | binary-valued vector

params.name: Maximum Word Length
params.values: Maximum output word length 64 (default) | integer in the range [1, 65535]

params.name: Output bit order
params.values: Output bit order LSB first (default) | MSB first
